title: RNA Extraction, Reverse Transcription and PCR for TMSB4X
author: Vinay Saunders
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rvbd62n
materials: 200 μl chloroform was added and samples shaken vigorously for 30 secs, then incubated at room temperature for 15 mins before being centrifuged at 12,000 g for 15 mins. The clear aqueous phase containing the RNA (top layer) was transferred to a new RNase-free tube. 500 μl isopropanol and 1 μl RNA grade glycogen (20 mg/ml, Thermo Scientific) was added and the sample incubated at -80°C for 30 mins.
RNA concentrations were assessed using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer.

The PCR products obtained were separated on 2% agarose gels containing Nancy-520 (Sigma Aldrich). An in-house 100 bp ladder was run alongside samples. Gels were run in Tris-acetate-EDTA buffer at 70-80 V until samples were resolved.
PCR was carried out using a G-Storm GS1 thermocycler, using standard temperature cycles for amplification of cDNA with an annealing temperature of 58°C.

steps.title: Tissue Homogenization
steps.instruction: Extract RNA from tissue previously stored in RNAlater.

substeps.instruction: Remove tissue from RNAlater and place in 1 ml TRIzol (Ambion).
Grind tissue using a plastic tissue grinder.
Incubate samples in TRIzol for 5 mins at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 12,000 g for 10 mins.
Transfer the supernatant to a new RNase-free tube to remove tissue debris.

steps.title: RNA Pellet Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the RNA from the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Bring samples to room temperature and incubate for 15 mins.
Centrifuge at 12,000 g for 15 mins at 4°C to form an RNA pellet.

steps.title: RNA Pellet Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellets while working on ice.

substeps.instruction: Discard the supernatant.
Wash cell pellets twice for 10 mins in pre-chilled (-20°C) 75% ethanol.
Centrifuge at 7,500 g for 10 mins at 4°C between washes.

steps.title: RNA Recovery and Stabilization
steps.instruction: Dry and resuspend the RNA pellets.

substeps.instruction: Remove all ethanol and let pellets air dry for 5-10 mins.
Resuspend pellets in 30 μl DEPC-treated water.
Treat samples with rRNasin RNase inhibitor (Promega).

steps.title: DNase Treatment and Reverse Transcription
steps.instruction: Remove genomic DNA and synthesize cDNA from RNA samples.

substeps.instruction: Treat RNA samples with RQ1 RNase-free DNase (Promega) according to manufacturer's instructions.
Reverse transcribe to cDNA using M-MLV Reverse Transcriptase (Promega) and Random Primers (Promega) according to manufacturer's instructions.
Create 'no reverse transcriptase' controls by substituting water for the reverse transcriptase enzyme.
Create 'no template' negative controls by substituting water for the template RNA.
Store reverse transcription products at -20°C.

steps.title: PCR Amplification of TMSB4X
steps.instruction: Perform PCR to detect TMSB4X transcripts.

substeps.instruction: Use GoTaq polymerase (Promega) with dNTPs and specific primers.
Use Forward primer: GAAGACAGAGACGCAAGAGAAAAA
Use Reverse primer: TGCCAGCCAGATAGATAGACAGAT

steps.title: Gel Imaging
steps.instruction: Image the resulting gels using a High Performance Ultraviolet Transilluminator (UVP) and DocIT software (UVP).
